states.deerNote: All Colorado deer licenses are limited and issued by game management unit through the draw, a lottery: you apply and may or may not get a license. Dates come from the 2025-2029 Big Game Season Structure adopted by the Parks and Wildlife Commission; the late plains rifle season follows its rule (Dec. 1 to 14).

states.deerNote: The Wildlife Resources Division (WRD) says the season ends Jan. 10, 2027 for most hunters; some counties have extended firearms or archery dates listed in the 2026-27 regulations guidebook. states.name: North Dakota
states.agency: North Dakota Game and Fish Department
states.deerNote: Nonresident bowhunters may hunt only on private land (not the PLOTS walk-in areas, Private Land Open To Sportsmen) during the first nine and a half days of the bow season. Gun and muzzleloader licenses are drawn by lottery.

lic.note: North Dakota deer hunters also need a fishing, hunting and furbearer certificate ($2 resident, $5 nonresident) and, per the guide, a general game and habitat license ($20) or a combination license.
